remarks.zh: 计算柜体板材的尺寸。[Width], [Height],[Depth] 是总测量尺寸， [BoardThick] 是顶部、底部和侧板的厚度，[BackBoardThick] 是后板的材料厚度。(AI translated, please check)
remarks.en: Calculates board sizes for a cabinet. [Width], [Height],[Depth] is total Measurement, [BoardThick] is Top, Bottom and Side Board material thickness, [BackBoardThick] is Background Board material thickness.
remarks.ms: Mengira saiz papan untuk kabinet. [Width], [Height], [Depth] ialah ukuran keseluruhan. [BoardThick] ialah ketebalan bahan papan atas, bawah dan sisi, [BackBoardThick] ialah ketebalan bahan papan belakang. (AI translated, please check)
remarks.id: Menghitung ukuran papan untuk kabinet. [Width], [Height], [Depth] adalah ukuran total. [BoardThick] adalah ketebalan bahan papan atas, bawah, dan samping, [BackBoardThick] adalah ketebalan bahan papan belakang. (AI translated, please check)
remarks.th: คำนวณขนาดกระดานสำหรับตู้ [Width], [Height], [Depth] คือขนาดรวม [BoardThick] คือความหนาของวัสดุกระดานด้านบน ด้านล่าง และด้านข้าง [BackBoardThick] คือความหนาของวัสดุกระดานด้านหลัง (AI translated, please check)
remarks.vi: Tính kích thước bảng cho tủ. [Width], [Height], [Depth] là kích thước tổng. [BoardThick] là độ dày vật liệu bảng trên, dưới và bên, [BackBoardThick] là độ dày vật liệu bảng nền. (AI translated, please check)
remarks.tl: Kinakalkula ang mga sukat ng tabla para sa kabinet. Ang [Width], [Height], [Depth] ay kabuuang sukat. Ang [BoardThick] ay ang kapal ng materyales ng tabla sa itaas, ibaba, at gilid. Ang [BackBoardThick] ay kapal ng materyales ng tabla sa likod. (AI translated, please check)
remarks.my: ကက်ဘိနက်အတွက် သစ်သားအမူအရာများတွက်ချက်သည်။ [Width], [Height], [Depth] သည် စုစုပေါင်းတိုင်းတာချက်ဖြစ်သည်။ [BoardThick] သည်ထိပ်၊ အောက်ခြေ နှင့် ခြစ်တည့်သောဖော်ထုတ်မှုအထူမှန်ဘီလူးဖြစ်ပြီး၊ [BackBoardThick] သည်နောက်ခံဘုတ်အဖွင့်အထူဖြစ်သည်။ (AI translated, please check)
remarks.km: គណនាទំហំបន្ទះសម្រាប់ទូ។ [Width], [Height], [Depth] គឺជាតួលេខសរុប៖ [BoardThick] គឺជាបន្ទះទ្វារ ក្រោម និងផ្នែកមួយ ធ្មេញរបស់សម្ភារៈបន្ទះពីក្រោយ។ [BackBoardThick] គឺជាកម្រាស់សម្ភារៈបន្ទះពីក្រោយ។ (AI translated, please check)
remarks.lo: ຄໍານວນຂະຫນາດເບື້ອງໃນສຳລັບຕູ້. [Width], [Height], [Depth] ແມ່ນລົມເບິ່ງຕົ້ນ, [BoardThick] ຫນາຄົນຂອງ ທ້ອນ, ລຸ່ມໃໝ່ທຶນ мусги [BackBoardThick] ຫນາຄົນ. (AI translated, please check)
remarks.ja: キャビネットの板サイズを計算します。[Width], [Height], [Depth] は総寸法を示し、[BoardThick] は上部、下部、側面の板材の厚さを示し、[BackBoardThick] は背板の材質の厚さを示します。(AI translated, please check)
remarks.ko: 캐비닛용 보드 크기를 계산합니다. [Width], [Height], [Depth]는 전체 치수이며 [BoardThick]는 상단, 하단 및 측면 보드 재료의 두께이고, [BackBoardThick]는 배경 보드 재료의 두께입니다. (AI translated, please check)
remarks.es: Calcula los tamaños de las tablas para un gabinete. [Width], [Height], [Depth] es la Medición total, [BoardThick] es el grosor del material de las tablas superior, inferior y lateral, [BackBoardThick] es el grosor del material de la tabla de fondo. (AI translated, please check)
remarks.fr: Calcule les dimensions des planches pour une armoire. [Width], [Height], [Depth] sont les dimensions totales, [BoardThick] est l'épaisseur du matériau des planches du haut, du bas et des côtés, [BackBoardThick] est l'épaisseur du matériau de la planche de fond. (AI translated, please check)
remarks.de: Berechnet die Plattengrößen für einen Schrank. [Width], [Height], [Depth] ist die Gesamtmessung. [BoardThick] ist die Dicke des Materials der oberen, unteren und seitlichen Platten, [BackBoardThick] ist die Dicke des Materials der Rückwandplatte. (AI translated, please check)
remarks.hi: कैबिनेट के लिए बोर्ड का आकार गणना करें। [Width], [Height], [Depth] कुल माप है, [BoardThick] शीर्ष, नीचे और साइड बोर्ड सामग्री की मोटाई है, [BackBoardThick] बैकग्राउंड बोर्ड सामग्री की मोटाई है। (AI translated, please check)
remarks.ru: Вычисляет размеры досок для шкафа. [Width], [Height], [Depth] — общие размеры, [BoardThick] — это толщина материала для верхней, нижней и боковых досок, [BackBoardThick] — это толщина материала для задней доски. (AI translated, please check)
